## Appearance

A slender and tall individual, Anne possesses a pointed face with a pale, milk-white skin tone and freckles, including seven on her nose. Her prominent eyes are large and variously described as solemn, gray-green, or luminous gray. She has long, slender fingers and features an oval girlish cheek. Her famous red hair, also called auburn or [Titian](../character/titian.md), has been worn in long braids, closely shingled, as short silky curls, and adorned with loosened rings around her neck and forehead.

## Personality

A smart, earnest, and passionate individual, she possesses a vivid imagination but is notably prone to daydreaming, heedless impulsiveness, and a short temper. She is highly serious-minded, strong-willed, romantic, and loyal, yet she often flies high in anticipation only to drop into sudden despair. Known for being an understanding listener, she remains firmly opposed to corporal punishment. Her primary motivations have included entering teaching and attending college, striving academically to win scholarships, making loved ones proud, and adding beauty to life. Possessing talent in writing, storytelling, and singing, she also has an innate way with children. Despite her determination, she faces a deep fear of failing in front of her rival and fears passing through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley was an orphan who lived with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), and in an asylum before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) fourteen years prior to her marriage. Though [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially intended to send her back because they had expected a boy, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) eventually agreed to keep and raise her. Anne formed a deep bond with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), created the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and pursued higher education at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Despite rejecting early proposals from classmates, she eventually accepted [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and the couple married and relocated to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). In their new home, Anne became close friends with her tragic neighbor [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) and the elderly lighthouse keeper Captain Jim. After suffering the loss of her firstborn daughter, Joyce, Anne later gave birth to a healthy son named James Matthew. Following Captain Jim's peaceful death, Anne and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) prepared to leave their initial home of dreams to move into a larger house in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen).

## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

> "I love pretty things; and I hate to look in the glass and see something that isn’t pretty. It makes me feel so sorrowful—just as I feel when I look at any ugly thing. I pity it because it isn’t beautiful."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P45](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0045)

> "I love Green Gables already, and I never loved any place before. No place ever seemed like home. Oh, Marilla, I’m so happy. I could pray right now and not find it a bit hard."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)

> "Oh, Marilla, I’m frightened—now that it has come I’m actually frightened. What if she shouldn’t like me! It would be the most tragical disappointment of my life."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P10](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0010)

## Relationships

### [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--bertha-shirley.md)

[Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) was Anne's mother [R1]. During a trip to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), Anne visits the house where she was born and receives a packet of old letters written by her parents [S1]. After reading these letters and visiting her parents' grave, Anne feels that she finally knows them truly [S1].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P11](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0011), +3 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's sworn bosom friend and constant companion, with whom she plays, attends school, and rows on the pond [R2, R3, S2, S3]. Their deep bond is formed early when they swear an oath of eternal friendship at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) [S2]. Anne cherishes the relationship immensely, even weeping at the imagined future prospect of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) getting married and leaving her [S4]. She also earns the [Barry](../character/barry.md) family's lasting gratitude and permission to resume their friendship after successfully nursing Diana's little sister through a severe bout of croup [S5].

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne and Gilbert's relationship evolves from a bitter childhood enmity into a loving marriage [R7, R10]. Their initial grudge begins when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' leading Anne to smash a slate over his head and refuse his apology [S8]. Though they remain fierce academic rivals throughout their school years, Anne secretly forgives him and later refuses his rescue offer after being stranded on a bridge pile [R4, S11, S12]. Over time, their hostility softens into literary collaboration and close friendship before Gilbert's long-held romantic feelings culminate in their marriage by Volume 4 [R5, R8, R9, R10].

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Anne's adoptive mother and dear friend who grants her a home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) [R16, R17, S27]. Though initially shocked to receive a girl instead of a boy, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decides against returning her to an unwanted life of servitude and resolves to raise and educate her [S25, S27, S28]. Despite frequently scolding Anne's dramatic daydreams and mishaps, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grows deeply affectionate toward her and provides steady guidance as Anne grows into adulthood [S26, S30, S34, S36].
